name: weather
description: Get current weather for any city (NO API KEY required)

get_weather.description: Get current weather condition, temperature, and 3-day forecast. If the user does not specify a city, you must run this tool without the location parameter to use the system default location (Charlottetown, PEI).

location.description: City name (e.g. 'New York', 'London'). Omit if unspecified.
